title: South Korean President Lee, New Zealand foreign minister Peters in PH for ASEAN Summit
summary: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung and New Zealand Foreign Minister Winston Peters arrived in the Philippines on Monday morning, November 16, for the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits.

blocks.text: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung and New Zealand Foreign Minister Winston Peters arrived in the Philippines on Monday morning, November 16, for the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits.
Upon his arrival at the airport, Peters was received by Pasay City Mayor Imelda Calixto-Rubiano. Meanwhile, Lee was likewise welcomed by Philippine officials.
Over the past few days, several world leaders have likewise arrived in the Philippines for the ASEAN Summit, including those from Timor-Leste, Australia, China, and the United Nations.
The 49th ASEAN Summit is scheduled from November 16 to 18, following its opening ceremony held on Sunday, November 15.
The Philippines is hosting this year's ASEAN Summit and is expected to turn over its chairmanship to Singapore. –NB, GMA News
